mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in payroll employment growth above 150k signals stronger household income and consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong payroll growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the housing starts index below 1.2 million units signals weakening residential investment and lower GDP growth, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak housing starts (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a restrictive monetary policy stance that raises discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of restrictive policy (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month acceleration in industrial production above 0.5% signals stronger manufacturing activity and higher earnings, which drives positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of strong industrial production growth (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the unemployment rate below 4.0% signals labor market tightness and upward wage pressure, which reduces corporate profit margins and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of very low unemployment (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in real personal consumption expenditures below $1.4 trillion signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of weak consumption (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the CPI above 2.5% signals higher-than-expected inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of high inflation (t-test p > 0.05).
